digitization.uncertainty_rule: For each point, combine half the between-repeat coordinate difference and one-pixel axis-calibration resolution in quadrature; compare model error to the larger of this digitization uncertainty and the 25% headline engineering tolerance.

stop_rules: Do not select a final photon count from the 1e5-1e7 pilot alone.
Do not launch all 277 sources at 1e9 until the 1e8 representative-source tier passes and storage/runtime estimates are recorded.
Do not tune anatomy, optical properties, source geometry, or normalization after inspecting reproduced headline errors; version any change as a new approximation.
Stop interpretation if independent-seed CV or step-change thresholds fail in any primary tissue integral or the valid 20-60 mm profile region.
